memHeapNote: The game's own heap while playing, from Low to High quality. Chapters release what they loaded when they end.
memDesktopNote: Measured in play on an Apple-silicon MacBook (chapter 4, 1440 × 810 window): the whole desktop app, engine and graphics process included, used about 0.5 GB on Low and 0.7 GB on High. An empty window of the same engine showing a blank 3D canvas uses 0.24 GB.
